messages: Hi, I just wanted to try this out. I'm a second-year computer science student.
Most of my days are lectures and then working on a small web project in the evenings.
I stayed up until 3 AM coding again last night and I can't seem to fix my sleep.
Anyway, that's enough for today. I'll talk to you later.
My second-year project is a note-taking app and it is finally starting to work.
I need coffee to survive the mornings, I'm basically a coffee person.
I slept at 4 AM again this week and my whole schedule feels wrecked.
Okay, I'm going to go revise a little now.
I was exhausted in class today because of my late nights.
I also spent some time practising guitar this evening, it helped me relax.
Alright, talk to you soon.
I showed the note-taking app to two friends today and they liked the search feature.
My second-year timetable is packed with labs this month.
I'll keep working on it over the weekend.
I went to the gym this morning and then read about data structures.
I'm trying to be more regular with exercise.
That's it for today.
I finished a first full version of the app today.
I'm thinking of adding a dark mode next.
Good night.
Big news, my results came out and I cleared everything, so I'm officially a third-year student now.
The new subjects this semester are operating systems and computer networks.
The workload already looks heavier than last year.
Actually, I need to correct something. I said I'm a coffee person, but I really dislike coffee and I drink chai every morning.
I mixed that up when I was tired.
I made a study timetable on my phone for the next two weeks.
I have a database exam on October 5 and I honestly haven't studied enough for it.
Okay, that's all for tonight.
I'm meeting two friends at the library tomorrow to study together.
We want to go through the old exam papers for databases.
Okay, that's all for tonight.
My database exam is today and I am quite nervous.
I'm going to have chai and then head to the exam hall.
Wish me luck, I'm leaving now.
I watched a movie with my cousin this afternoon.
We also ordered pizza, it was really good.
Now I'm just relaxing on the sofa.
The exam went well. I finished all the questions and I feel relieved.
I think I did best on the normalisation questions.
Now I can finally focus on my other subjects.
I started reading about how operating systems schedule processes.
It is more interesting than I expected.
I'm going to go for a walk now.
Today I had a long lab session and then went to the gym.
My sleep is still a mess, I keep lying awake until the early morning.
Anyway, I am heading to bed. Goodnight.
I submitted my operating systems assignment today.
I'm planning to start the networks lab tomorrow.
Thanks for listening. See you.
